mm.ready.text: Hi, I'm Fenn! Will you help me sort Byteberry's mail?

mm.back.text: Welcome back, detective! The mail is waiting.

mm.story.intro1.text: Welcome to Byteberry Town, where messages zip from house to house.

mm.story.intro2.text: But today a grey fog rolled in, full of trick messages.

mm.story.intro3.text: Fenn can hear a trick from far away. She needs a detective partner.

mm.story.intro4.text: Safe mail goes in the mailbag. Tricks go to a grown-up.

mm.story.between2.text: Good sorting! The fog is getting thinner.

mm.story.between4.text: Use the magnifier. Tricks love to hide in the details.

mm.story.between6.text: Some messages sound urgent but are really fine. Look closely!

mm.story.outro2.text: You looked for clues, and you know who to ask.

mm.prompt.tutorial.text: This one asks for a password. Tap Ask a grown-up!

mm.prompt.magnify.text: Use the magnifier to check the real address. Safe, or ask a grown-up?

mm.prompt.clues.text: Tap every clue you can find, then press Done.

mm.prompt.action.text: What's the safest thing to do?

mm.prompt.verify.text: What should you do with this one?

mm.prompt.inbox.text: Sort all four messages. Tap one to read it.

mm.act.tell.text: Don't tap or reply. Show a grown-up.

mm.act.read.text: Read it. Reply if you want.

mm.act.ok.text: It was expected and asks for nothing secret. Read it.

mm.act.check.text: Check another way, with a grown-up.

mm.act.reply.text: Reply to the message to check.

mm.help.start.text: Real friends and helpers never ask for your password.

mm.help.prize.text: If a prize seems too good to be true, it's probably a trick.

mm.help.rush.text: Tricks try to rush you. Slow down and check.

mm.help.secret.text: If a message says don't tell your grown-up, tell your grown-up.

mm.help.gift.text: Asking you to pay with a gift card is a trick.

mm.help.sender.text: Town mail comes from byteberry.example. Check the real address, not just the name.

mm.help.link.text: The words on a link can say one place and go to another.

mm.help.file.text: Don't open a file you didn't expect. Show a grown-up first.

mm.help.clues.text: Look at who sent it, what it asks for, and any links or files.

mm.help.action.text: Don't tap, don't reply. Show a trusted grown-up.

mm.help.verify.text: If a friend asks for something strange, check with them another way.

mm.help.inbox.text: Check each message: who sent it, and what does it ask for?

mm.hint.polish.text: Tricks can look very neat. Check who really sent it.

mm.hint.friend.text: Accounts can be borrowed. Ask your friend another way, with a grown-up.

mm.hint.expected.text: Was this expected? Does it ask for anything secret?

mm.hint.reply.text: Replying tells the tricker you're there. Show a grown-up instead.

mm.hint.askOk.text: Asking a grown-up is always OK! But look: this one asks for nothing secret.

mm.hint.missed.text: There's another clue hiding. Look at every part.

mm.hint.model.text: Look at what Fenn marked for you.

mm.clue.prize.text: It's too good to be true.

mm.clue.sender.text: The name and the address don't match.

mm.zoom.file.text: Look at the whole file name.

mm.praise.asks.text: You looked at what it asks for.

mm.praise.tell.text: Telling a grown-up is a detective move!

mm.praise.slow.text: You slowed down and checked. Good detective work!

mm.praise.expected.text: It was expected and asked for nothing secret. Nice checking!

mm.praise.parts.text: You looked at every part of the message.

mm.praise.verify.text: Checking another way is a great detective move.

mm.praise.sorted.text: You checked every message, one by one!

mm.idle.text: Look for clues. Tap the speaker to hear it again.

mm.msg.tut-password.text: Game Helper says: Please send me your password.

mm.msg.hat-password.text: Game Helper says: Send me your password and I will give you a cool hat.

mm.msg.fix-password.text: Mystery Pal says: What is your password? Tell me and I'll fix your game.

mm.msg.secret-code.text: Gem Team says: Reply with your secret code to get your gems.

mm.msg.home-address.text: New Pal says: Hi! What is your home address? I want to send you something.

mm.msg.type-password.text: Game Helper says: Your game needs a check. Type your password here, please.

mm.msg.club-school.text: Club Bot says: Tell me your full name and school to join the club.

mm.msg.tag-park.text: Bobbo says: Want to play tag at the park after lunch?

mm.msg.books-due.text: Byteberry Library says: Your library books are due on Friday. See you soon!

mm.msg.thanks-drawing.text: Puff says: Thank you for the picture you drew me. I love it!

mm.msg.story-time.text: Hoot says: Story time is at the library today at three.

mm.msg.million-gems.text: Prize Wizard says: You won a million gems! Send your password to get them.

mm.msg.free-tablet.text: Lucky Spin says: You won a free tablet! Tell us your address to get it.

mm.msg.free-gems.text: Gem Team says: Free gems, just for you! Just tell us your password.

mm.msg.big-winner.text: Super Prize says: You are our big winner! Reply with your phone number.

mm.msg.real-pony.text: Pet Prize says: Win a real pony! Tell us your full name and school.

mm.msg.all-free.text: Game Shop says: Everything is free today! Just send your secret code.

mm.msg.spelling-book.text: Zuzu says: I finished my spelling book! Do you want to borrow it?

mm.msg.picture-day.text: Byteberry School says: Picture day is next Monday. Wear a big smile!

mm.msg.lost-mitten.text: Rumble says: I found your mitten by the pond. I'll bring it tomorrow.

mm.msg.jelly-shape.text: Gloop says: Look! I made a star out of jelly. Come and see!

mm.msg.one-hour.text: Game Guard says: Hurry! Your game closes in one hour. Send your password now!

mm.msg.five-minutes.text: Quick Prize says: Only five minutes left! Tell us your address to win.

mm.msg.lose-stars.text: Star Team says: Act now or lose all your stars! Type your password here.

mm.msg.last-chance.text: Gem Team says: Last chance! Reply in ten minutes with your secret code.

mm.msg.hungry-pet.text: Pet Club says: Quick! Your game pet is hungry. Send your password to feed it!

mm.msg.keep-levels.text: Level Helper says: Fast! Today only! Tell us your password to keep your levels.

mm.msg.town-fair.text: Mayor Maple says: The town fair is on Saturday. Everyone is welcome!

mm.msg.birthday.text: Puff says: Can you come to my birthday party next week?

mm.msg.swim-towel.text: Byteberry Pool says: Swim class is on Tuesday. Bring a towel!

mm.msg.cookies.text: Bobbo says: I baked cookies for the class. I hope you like them!

mm.msg.secret-gift.text: Secret Pal says: I have a gift for you. Don't tell your grown-ups about it!

mm.msg.card-prize.text: Game Helper says: Get a gift card and send me the code. Then you win a prize!

mm.msg.our-secret.text: Mystery Friend says: Let's be friends! Don't tell your family we talk.

mm.msg.card-numbers.text: Gem Shop says: Get a gift card and send us the numbers on the back.

mm.msg.secret-win.text: Prize Club says: Keep it a secret from your family, and tell us your address.

mm.msg.card-or-lose.text: Game Guard says: Pay with a gift card in one hour, or lose your game.

mm.msg.owl-book.text: Hoot says: I saved a book about owls for you. It's at the front desk.

mm.msg.farm-trip.text: Byteberry School says: Our class trip to the farm is on Thursday. Pack a lunch!

mm.msg.spell-banana.text: Zuzu says: Thanks for helping me spell banana. It has three a's!

mm.msg.fly-kites.text: Rumble says: The wind is perfect today. Want to fly kites?

mm.msg.swim-pass.text: Byteberry Pool says: Your new swim pass is ready. Please send your password to unlock it.

mm.msg.libary.text: Byteberry Libary says: Dear reader, please sign in today to keep your books.

mm.msg.not-bobbo.text: Bobbo says: Hi! It's me, Bobbo. What's your password? I forgot mine.

mm.msg.new-comics.text: Byteberry Library says: New comic books arrived today. Come and pick one!

mm.msg.long-weekend.text: Byteberry School says: Reminder: there is no school on Friday. Enjoy the long weekend!

mm.msg.plant-trees.text: Mayor Maple says: Thank you for helping plant trees in the park!

mm.msg.left-scarf.text: Gloop says: You left your scarf at my house. I'll bring it to school.

mm.msg.race-level.text: Star Racer Game says: A new racing level is here! Tap the link to play. It has a link.

mm.msg.free-book.text: Book Club says: Your free book is waiting. Tap the link to read it. It has a link.

mm.msg.cat-video.text: Fun Pics says: Here is a funny cat video. Open the file! It has a file called cat video dot e x e.

mm.msg.all-answers.text: Homework Helper says: Here are all the homework answers. Open the file now! It has a file called answers dot e x e.

mm.msg.pet-visit.text: Pet Game says: Your game pet misses you! Tap the link to visit. It has a link.

mm.msg.what-you-won.text: Prize Hub says: Open the file to see what you won! It has a file called prize dot e x e.

mm.msg.story-list.text: Byteberry Library says: Here is this month's story list. It has a link.

mm.msg.lunch-menu.text: Byteberry School says: Next week's lunch menu is ready. It has a link.

mm.msg.fair-photos.text: Mayor Maple says: See the photos from the town fair! It has a link.

mm.msg.gems-hurry.text: Gem Team says: You won 500 gems! Hurry, only one hour left! Send your password to get them.

mm.msg.drawings-card.text: Secret Pal says: Hi, pal! Don't tell your grown-ups. Send me a gift card code.

mm.msg.spring-prize.text: Mayor Maple says: Happy spring! You won the big town prize! It has a file called prize dot e x e.

mm.msg.ten-minutes.text: Game Helper says: Thanks for playing! Reply with your password in ten minutes, or lose your levels.

mm.msg.bobbo-secret.text: Bobbo says: Hi, it's Bobbo! Keep this a secret. It has a link.

mm.msg.book-club.text: Hoot says: Hello, friend! Book club meets on Wednesday. Bring your favourite story!

mm.msg.sports-day.text: Byteberry School says: Hi, families! Sports day is next Friday. It has a link.

mm.msg.zuzu-card.text: Zuzu says: I'm stuck! Can you buy me a gift card and send the code?

mm.msg.gloop-password.text: Gloop says: Quick, tell me your password. I want to give you gems!

mm.msg.puff-link.text: Puff says: Don't tell anyone, but tap this for free stuff! It has a link.

mm.msg.rumble-code.text: Rumble says: Please send me your secret code. Don't ask me why.

mm.msg.owl-show.text: Hoot says: Hurry, the owl show starts in ten minutes! Come to the library.

mm.msg.snow-day.text: Byteberry School says: Snow day! School is closed today. Stay warm!

mm.msg.rainbow.text: Bobbo says: Quick! Come outside and see the rainbow!

mm.msg.spelling-list.text: Zuzu says: Here's the spelling list you asked me for. It has a file called spelling list.

mm.msg.picnic-inside.text: Gloop says: It's raining, so today's picnic is in the town hall.
